# Gifty

> Social gift wallet. Send ETH by gift link or username. Recipients sign in with Privy, get a free ENSv2 name on gifty.eth, and claim on Base.

- Site: https://gifty.energia.dev
- Source: https://github.com/beeinger/gifty
- Spec: https://github.com/beeinger/gifty/blob/main/mission.md

## Product

Gifty is for sending ETH to people who do not have a wallet yet. A sender locks ETH into a gift and shares a link. The recipient signs in with Privy (email or Google), picks a free username, and claims the ETH.

The gift is ETH behind a secret. The ENS name is created at signup, not attached to the link. Bare names such as `vitalik` resolve to `vitalik.gifty.eth`. Full ENS names and `0x` addresses still work.

Money lives on Base. Usernames live on Sepolia because ENS v2 beta is Sepolia-only. The app does not ask the user to switch networks. Username registration gas is operator-sponsored.

## What is live

- Privy production login and embedded self-custodial wallets on Base
- Free ENSv2 subnames under gifty.eth
- Gift create and ZK claim on Base (Circom Poseidon circuit, snarkjs PLONK, on-chain verifier)
- Privy fiat onramp to Base USDC
- Privy crypto deposit into Base ETH
- Privy wallet swaps between ETH and USDC on Base
- Operator-sponsored claim when the recipient has no Base ETH (small fee from the gift); self-paid claim is free of that fee

## What is not live

- Spend card issuing (UI is a demo; KYB / Bridge is not set up)
- Pay by phone number

## Stack

- Next.js app (Bun)
- Privy for auth, wallets, onramp, swaps
- Solidity contracts: GiftyClaimer, GiftyVerifier, GiftyRegistrar (Foundry)
- ENSv2 on Sepolia: parent gifty.eth, UserRegistry, Permissioned Resolver
- Circom `gifty_claim` + snarkjs PLONK
